name: Ichijou Kouga
source:
Pacific Ocean Super Power Instruction Institution 3rd year student. Captain of the Superpower Club.
He used to be a part of the Akizuki High team with Azuma and Yamato but he transferred schools when the team was suspended.
For the sake of victory he has no qualms against breaking the rules and using dirty tactics.
He has the superpower "Precognition" that allows him to see a few seconds into the future.
translation:
Pacific Ocean Super Power Instruction Institution 3rd year student. Captain of the Superpower Club.
He used to be a part of the Akizuki High team with Azuma and Yamato but he transferred schools when the team was suspended.
For the sake of victory he has no qualms against breaking the rules and using dirty tactics.
He has the superpower "Precognition" that allows him to see a few seconds into the future.
